items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: a drummer that was with him, Kansas Fields, I think was playing drums for him at the time

ctx.x: We played the Savoy, so I was up there for six more months with Willie Bryant. We played the Savoy. And then, that's when I heard from Cab Calloway -- a drummer that was with him, Kansas Fields, I think was playing drums for him at the time, and he was looking for a drummer, and this was when I made -- he was getting ready to do a movie at the time when I joined the band, "The Hide Ho Man" up in the Bronx, he was doing it -- called "The Hide Ho Man", and that's when I joined the band and we made the record
of "The Hidy Ho Man", that's me. I'll never forget that -- that was a big thrill for me.
